events.verdict: Nembhard (IND) places his forearm against Wallace (OKC) and releases away.
Hartenstein (OKC) briefly grasps Turner's (IND) jersey and immediately releases it as they pursue the rebound.
Wallace (OKC) firms up in a screening position in Nembhard's (IND) path and does not deliver contact.
Siakam (IND) initiates contact with Hartenstein's (OKC) arm, which affects his layup attempt.
Williams (OKC) and Siakam (IND) engage and disengage in the post.
Williams (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Siakam (IND) in the post.

Although Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) makes contact with the ball when he reaches in, he initiates illegal contact to Mathurin (IND) before and after the contact to the ball that affects his driving shot attempt.
Hartenstein (OKC) establishes himself in a screening position in Nembhard's (IND) path and absorbs the contact.
Mathurin (IND) contests Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Turner (IND) establishes himself in Wallace's (OKC) path and slightly extends his arm against his back as they disengage.
Mathurin (IND) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Wallace (OKC) moves alongside Nembhard's (IND) path to the basket before cleanly blocking the shot attempt.
Siakam (IND) passes the ball from the frontcourt to Haliburton (IND), who is established in the backcourt.
Hartenstein (OKC) briefly places his hands against Nembhard (IND) as he sets the screen prior to correcting.
Turner (IND) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
Nembhard (IND) gathers the ball on his right foot and hops consecutively on the same foot after his gather.
Haliburton (IND) commits a take foul on Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC).
